notes:
Summary: HelixFlow is the CX platform for a fast-growing retail marketplace (1200 support agents in NA/EU). Primary ask = reliable agent-assist + ticket summarization during 4x seasonal peaks (holiday sales) and sudden incident bursts.

Key requirements / quotes:
- "We need sub-300ms median + 95th < 350ms for agent assist, otherwise agents complain of lag." - Sr. Ops
- target throughput: baseline 1k reqs/min, peak 5k-8k reqs/min for short windows (10-90 mins).
- Must support tool-calling (CRM actions) with idempotency controls and audit trails.
- Backpressure behavior: prefer graceful degradation (priority routing for VIP SLAs -> fallback to smaller model + cache hits) over errors.
- Data controls: VPC + KMS, 90-day transcript retention, EU residency for EU customers.

Technical notes from SE call:
- Observed pathological queue build-up when MPS drops; interested in Redwood's burst capacity + circuit-breaker semantics.
- Wants automatic KV/prefix caching across repeated agent prompts to reduce token cost and latency for follow-ups.
- Wants routing policy: route by SLA tier then by cost-optimization (dedicated pool first, hosted fallback).
- Asking for admission control: limit in-flight tokens per agent, global concurrent streams cap.

POC success criteria (customer stated):
1) Stable 95p latency <= 350ms under synthetic 3x baseline spike for 30 mins
2) No >5% p50 regression in summarization quality vs baseline model
3) Demonstrated safe fallback to smaller quantized variant w/ preserved tool-calling integrity
